adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "lark-calendar", credential.userId)`. When syncing is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), `refreshOAuthTokens` posts to the sync endpoint and returns that response. But the Lark code still immediately parses the response with `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, ...)`, which is provider-specific (expects Lark’s refresh token response shape). This conflicts with the stated contract in `refreshOAuthTokens` (“response should only contain the access token and expiry date”), and would break refresh for Lark (and similarly for other integrations still using provider-specific response parsing) when sync mode is enabled.
